entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SyntaxKind is missing NIntKeyword and NUIntKeyword #81681
  • CS8618 suggests using `required` on events. #81679

Closed

  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11312.147 #81677

PullRequests

Created

  • Small allocation reduction in lsp hot path #81683
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Copy slightly less data during SourceText.computeContentHash #81682
    Area-Compilers
  • Don't report assignment to ref extension parameter as unused #81680
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81678
    Area-Infrastructure

Updated

  • DeclarationTable allocation reductions #81627
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix null refs when calling `GetLocation()` or `GetDiagnostics()` of freshly constructed syntax trivia #81444
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Add separate error for disallowed members in global namespace #81221
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs UX Triage, VSCode
  • Extension indexers: allow and resolve extension indexers #81607
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
  • Add specific error for extension parameter usage in static members #81606
    Area-IDE
  • Use ArrayExpansion for fixed buffer fields #81536
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Merge vs-extension-testing into Roslyn #81565
    Area-Infrastructure
